notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight legendary enchantments.
description:
Activate Hei Bai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each legendary enchantment you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar eight times by sacrificing eight Spirits, adding {3}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Hei Bai by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
